video_title: Stephen A. GOES OFF on De'Aaron Fox after Spurs' Game 4 collapse 🗣️ | First Take

quotes.speaker: Marcus Morris Sr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Morris Sr. on criticizing Victor Wembanyama's late-game performance
quotes.excerpt: You give him praise when he played well, you got to criticize him when he played bad.
quotes.quote: You give him praise when he played well, you got to criticize him when he played bad. All great players are criticized in tough moments, and for Wembanyama to have as bad of a game late in the game like he did yesterday and not be able to close it, you have to put it on him.

quotes.speaker: Marcus Morris Sr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Morris Sr. argues De'Aaron Fox is the Spurs' true point guard
quotes.excerpt: I think De'Aaron Fox is the point guard. I think he is the one that needs to put guys
quotes.quote: I think De'Aaron Fox is the point guard. I think he is the one that needs to put guys in the right position. He is the oldest veteran that is actually having experience. When things like this happen, it comes down to him.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith says De'Aaron Fox must run the show for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: He is there to run the show. This ain't Sacramento in the first round against Steph Curry.
quotes.quote: He is there to run the show. This ain't Sacramento in the first round against Steph Curry from years ago. He is there to run the show. And look at the young thoroughbreds that they have. You got Dylan Harper who can ball, you got Stefan Castle who can ball, you got Vassell who can ball, you got Champagnie who can ball. All of them are looking for their shot.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins says LeBron James would be held to a higher standard
quotes.excerpt: Oh, if this was LeBron James, the energy would not be the same.
quotes.quote: Oh, if this was LeBron James, the energy would not be the same, especially coming from you. And you know it. And Wembanyama is the reason why, but we are not about to sit up here and keep letting Wembanyama off the hook. We are not about to do that.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins compares Victor Wembanyama's defense to Rudy Gobert
quotes.excerpt: We are talking about the defensive player of the year. If this was Rudy Gobert, we would be
quotes.quote: We are talking about the defensive player of the year. If this was Rudy Gobert, we would be on here killing them right now.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith recalls LeBron James' first NBA Finals appearance
quotes.excerpt: When LeBron James lost in the finals to the San Antonio Spurs first go round, did we see
quotes.quote: When LeBron James lost in the finals to the San Antonio Spurs first go round, did we see anything about him? Nobody said a word because we knew he was overwhelmed and didn't have any help.
